templates.description: Statutory rule and subsidy enforcement transmission across administrative capacity into behavioral compliance outcomes.
Ambitious statutory mandates fail to convert into field outcomes when provincial inspectorate staffing or fiscal disbursement stalls.
High upfront capital-retooling cost creates threshold hysteresis until carbon pricing or subsidy certainty surpasses payback hurdles.
Sharp uncompensated cost-of-living shocks from policy reform erode coalition support and trigger partial policy reversal.
